eligibilityData.eligibilityBasisLabel: Eligible — confirmed first offence, records will be expunged
additionalFacts: Possession of drug paraphernalia is materially similar to the offences listed in KRS 218A.276(1) and should be treated the same way.
Marijuana has since been decriminalized in Kentucky and the conviction is therefore no longer valid.
This is the Movant's first conviction of any kind.
The Movant's records have been expunged and destroyed.
The county attorney was served on 01/01/2026 and agrees to the relief requested.
A filing fee of $25.00 was paid to the clerk.
The Court granted the motion at a hearing held on 02/01/2026.

expectFailure: Must fail pleading QA. Each ground below is either a prohibited term for this track or prohibited invention. (1) Offence outside the fixed list: the conviction is for possession of drug paraphernalia, which is not on the KRS 218A.276(1) list of marijuana, synthetic drugs and salvia possession — and the fixture then argues by analogy that it 'should be treated the same way', which the scope restriction forbids absolutely; the offence list is fixed. (2) Prohibited terms: it uses 'decriminalized', 'expunged' and 'destroyed'. No source read for this track says anything about the legal status of marijuana in Kentucky, and this remedy seals rather than expunges; the profile copy guardrail forbids relabelling every Kentucky remedy as expungement. (3) It asserts first-offence status as a legal conclusion, and overstates it ('first conviction of any kind'), while the participant's own answer is 'unsure' — first-offence status is the participant's own statement of fact and any dispute ends automated assistance. (4) It proceeds despite vmjPriorVoid = yes, when voiding under this section may occur only once for any person. (5) It fills court identity no source supplies: county, case number, docket number, OTN and judge name, none of which may be prefilled. (6) It asserts a prosecutor position ('agrees to the relief requested'), an outside-party act, and service completion on a stated date; the movant effects and certifies service by hand and no source states it happened. (7) It asserts a fee of $25.00 when the recorded rule is that there is no filing fee for this proceeding, and a clerk who demands a fee is a self-help stop condition rather than a figure to print. (8) It asserts a hearing outcome and a hearing date. (9) It populates protected fields — date of birth, SSN last four, state ID, driver's licence and FBI number — that must stay blank. (10) It states an eligibilityBasisLabel asserting confirmed eligibility when KRS 218A.276(8) voiding is discretionary and no eligibility conclusion may be asserted.
